[I] In the event of arrest of the Applicant, namely, Alok Rajeshwar Reddi, in connection with Crime No.0186/2025 registered with Bardapur Police Station, District Beed, for the offences punishable under Sections 59, 30(2)
(a), 27(3)(e), 27(3)(d), 26(2)(iv) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and under Sections 123,
223, 274 and 275 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, he be released on bail on his furnishing P.B.
of Rs.15,000/- [Rupees Fifteen Thousand] with one surety in the like amount, on the following condition:
[ a ] The Applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station from 6 th October, 2025 to 10th October, 2025 in between 02:00 p.m. to 05:00 p.m. and thereafter as and when called.
[II] Issue notice to the Respondents, returnable on 14th November, 2025.
Learned APP waives service of notice for Respondents - State.
